front.coordinate_method: body-color + facial dark/cream mask; largest 4-connected component; enclosed-hole fill; retains outside leg gap; no smoothing or symmetrizing
front.view_normalization: All source absolute coordinates retained; dimensions may be scaled by this view projected height. Bbox midpoint is NOT anatomical axis because tails/ears are asymmetric.

limits: No hidden topology or original 3D shader can be recovered exactly from these 2D boards
No numeric reduction ratios from v04 are used
Silhouette pixel threshold changes edge positions; manual stations are marked separately
Visible thumbs are gesture-dependent; do not add visible fingers to a closed silhouette

palette.interpretation: brand base value and source swatch medians; not every shaded skin pixel

contour_resolution: source pixel-cell boundary only; no smoothing, ellipse replacement, mirror, or resculpting applied
normalization_policy: Canonical front reference is manual top-to-sole 214px (Daekimi) or 210px (Oejimong), consistent with earlier source reading; threshold mask bbox differs by 1-2px because of highlights/edge shading. Detected and manual bounds are separate. Other views are not forced to same pixel height.
part_dimension_note: Ball width/height are projected cap bounds, not exact 3D sphere diameter; stem box includes tilt and is not stem cross-sectional diameter; ears use visible lobe and seam landmarks.
